ideas.title: The Impact of Minnesota's Medicaid Fraud on Vulnerable Populations
ideas.description: This story could investigate the effects of the Medicaid fraud case on vulnerable populations in Minnesota, including those relying on Medicaid for healthcare.
ideas.angle: The human impact of large-scale Medicaid fraud
questions: How many people are affected by the fraud?
What are the long-term consequences for Medicaid recipients?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it sheds light on the consequences of large-scale Medicaid fraud on those who need healthcare the most.

ideas.title: DOJ's Handling of the Renee Good Death Investigation
ideas.description: This story could examine the DOJ's handling of the Renee Good death investigation and the implications of prosecutor resignations.
ideas.angle: The DOJ's response to allegations of political interference
questions: What were the reasons behind the prosecutor resignations?
How will the DOJ's handling of the case impact future investigations?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it raises questions about the DOJ's commitment to impartial investigations and the rule of law.
